targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM process_instances WHERE completed_at IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(sum(required_signatures-collected_signatures),0) AS value FROM process_instances WHERE status='AWAITING_SIGNATURES'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM process_instances WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND due_at < now()
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM process_instances WHERE completed_at >= date_trunc('day', now())
SELECT business_area AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM process_instances WHERE completed_at IS NULL GROUP BY business_area ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT business_area AS "Area", workflow_name AS "Processo", automation_owner AS "Responsavel", status AS "Status", required_signatures-collected_signatures AS "Assinaturas pendentes", due_at AS "Prazo" FROM process_instances WHERE completed_at IS NULL ORDER BY due_at ASC LIMIT 20
